trans-unit.target: TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_SEQ_00<tab>Ketenramm has much to discuss with you.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_TODO_00<tab>Speak with the Archive.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_001<tab>Speak with Jeffroy when yer ready to make for the North Horn. We can talk more when we get to the base camp.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_005<tab>I see that my initial assessment of “<var 1A 02 /var>un<var 1A 01 /var>familiar” still stands. What in the world is that irksome little rascal thinking?
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_IRIS_000_010<tab>You were guided to this isle...
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_015<tab>Hemmed in by imposing peaks on all sides... This region appears to be isolated from the rest of the island.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_IRIS_000_020<tab>What will you see in these strange lands?
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_030<tab>Our goals here are twofold: uncover the truth of the Occult Crescent and ensure the crew makes it home in one piece.

TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_031<tab>Now, I reckon findin' the isle's architect is key to achievin' both. Given that he's probably holed up in the Tower of Magic, findin' a way in should be our first order of business.

TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_032<tab>Accordin' to our scouts, the fiends in this part of the island are a damn sight tougher than the beasties we've encountered so far. If ye find yerself strugglin', ye'd best head back to the South Horn for a spot of trainin'.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_033<tab>I should also mention that the surveyors have turned up some interestin' new trinkets. Speak with the crew if that tickles yer fancy.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_034<tab>Oh, and don't forget to attune with the camp's aetheryte while yer here.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_035<tab>My friend, I wish to have a quick word with you. Let me know once you've completed your preparations.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_KETENRAMM_000_040<tab>Ye'd best get prepared. There's no tellin' what's waitin' for us outside the camp.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_IRIS_000_045<tab>This aetheryte won't provide passage to the South Horn...
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_100<tab>I was hoping we could discuss the soul shards─you know, those crystalline records of martial methods conceived by the twelve city-states of eld.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_101<tab>As you no doubt recall, I posited they would only function upon the isle itself. Was my hypothesis correct?
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_102<tab>Part of me had wondered whether you in particular might be able to wield the shards' power beyond the ward. Evidently not...
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_103<tab>In truth, I've also been pondering the reason you were summoned here in the first place.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_104<tab>If the voice you heard belongs to the island's architect, then seeking him out in the Tower of Magic ought to provide answers on that front too.
TEXT_KINGKD102_05512_ARCHIVE_000_106<tab>In other words, the time has come to venture forth once more!
